### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of hypoxia in astrocytes.

### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/camp/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Load Astrocyte data object

```{r}

de_object <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "01-erap2-overexpression-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))
diff_object <- de_object$differential_object
de_object_vst <- de_object$vst_matrix
de_contrast_list <- de_object$contrasts

```


### 5.0 Perform GSEA

- Plot volcano plot

```{r}

all_de_df_list <- lapply(names(de_contrast_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    a_de_object <- de_contrast_list[[x]]
    filter <- !is.na(a_de_object$padj)
    logfcs <- a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]

    data.frame(contrasts = x, 
        gene_ids = rownames(a_de_object)[filter],
        logfc = logfcs,
        pval = a_de_object$pvalue[filter],
        padj = a_de_object$padj[filter])
})
all_de_df <- do.call(rbind, all_de_df_list)

all_de_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(all_de_df$gene_id, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]


```


- Map Entrez IDs to Ensembl IDs

```{r}

library("AnnotationDbi")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
all_de_df$entrez_id = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys=all_de_df$gene_ids,
                    column="ENTREZID",
                    keytype="ENSEMBL",
                    multiVals="first")

```


- Perform C2 CP REACTOME gene set enrichment

```{r}

require("msigdbr")
require("fgsea")
require("parallel")

reactome_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "human", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")

msigdbr_list = split(x = reactome_gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = reactome_gene_sets$gs_name)


all_de_df_split <- split(all_de_df, all_de_df$contrasts)


reactome_gsea_df_list <- lapply(all_de_df_split, function(temp_df){
    temp_non_na_df <- temp_df[!is.na(temp_df$gene_name) & !is.na(temp_df$logfc) & !is.na(temp_df$padj),]
    temp_non_na_df$ranks <- rank(temp_non_na_df$logfc)
    temp_non_na_df <- temp_non_na_df[order(temp_non_na_df$logfc, decreasing = T),]
    a_vector <- temp_non_na_df$ranks
    names(a_vector) <- temp_non_na_df$gene_name
    fgsea(msigdbr_list, a_vector, maxSize = 200)
})


significant_reactome_gsea_df_list <- lapply(reactome_gsea_df_list, function(temp_df){
    temp_df[temp_df$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(temp_df$log2err),]
})


all_significant_reactome_gsea_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(significant_reactome_gsea_df_list), function(x){
    temp_df <- as.data.frame(significant_reactome_gsea_df_list[[x]])
    temp_df$contrast <- x
    return(temp_df)
}))


saveRDS(object = all_significant_reactome_gsea_df, file = file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_reactome_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
write.table(x = all_significant_reactome_gsea_df[,-8], sep = "\t", quote = F, col.names = T, row.names = F, file = file.path(output_dir,"erap2_overexpression_Reactome_GSEA_pval_0.05.txt"))

```
